domains.label: Shared Foundations
domains.description: Core engineering troubleshooting scenarios shared across pathways.

labs.title: Python environment mismatch
labs.scenario: A script runs locally but fails in CI with ModuleNotFoundError and version conflicts.
tasks: Identify the Python and dependency mismatch
Reproduce with a clean virtual environment
Pin dependencies and document the fix
hints: Check python --version and pip freeze
Compare requirements with installed packages
Use a fresh venv to validate
success_criteria: Dependencies install cleanly in a fresh environment
Tests or script run with the pinned versions
labs.reset_guidance: Delete and recreate the virtual environment, then reinstall from the pinned requirements file.
evidence: Short note explaining root cause and fix

labs.title: Git merge conflict recovery
labs.scenario: Two branches modify the same configuration and tests, producing conflicts.
tasks: Run validation and complete the merge
hints: Use git status and git diff
Prefer preserving intent over blindly choosing one side
success_criteria: No conflict markers remain
Relevant checks pass after resolution
labs.reset_guidance: Abort the merge/rebase and reapply changes from a clean branch state.

labs.title: API and configuration failure
labs.scenario: An API client returns 401/500 errors due to missing environment configuration and incorrect base URL.
hints: Check env vars, base URL, and auth headers
Avoid logging secrets
success_criteria: Configuration validated
API call succeeds with expected response
labs.reset_guidance: Restore example configuration values and restart the service/process.

labs.title: Database connection failure
labs.scenario: The application cannot connect to its database due to host/port, credentials, SSL, or migration-state issues.
tasks: Verify connection configuration and network reachability
Check credentials/secrets handling and database readiness
Apply the fix and confirm migrations/queries succeed
hints: Inspect DATABASE_URL/components and service logs
Confirm the database is running and accepting connections
Test with a minimal connection/check script
success_criteria: Connection succeeds with correct configuration
Required schema/migrations are in expected state
labs.reset_guidance: Restore known-good local database configuration and rerun initialization/migrations from a clean state as appropriate.

labs.title: Docker troubleshooting basics
labs.scenario: A containerized service fails to start or communicate because of image/build, port mapping, or volume/config issues.
tasks: Fix configuration and verify the service is reachable
hints: Use docker ps/logs/inspect
Check exposed ports, env vars, and mounted paths
success_criteria: Container starts healthy
Service behaves as expected on the configured interface/port
labs.reset_guidance: Stop/remove affected containers, rebuild images if needed, and restart from the baseline compose/run configuration.

domains.label: AI Engineering
domains.description: Troubleshooting scenarios for LLM applications, retrieval, agents, and deployment.

labs.title: Retrieval failure in a RAG pipeline
labs.scenario: Relevant documents are not retrieved, causing hallucinated or incomplete answers.
tasks: Inspect chunking/indexing and query embedding flow
Improve retrieval quality and validate answers
hints: Check chunk size/overlap and metadata filters
Compare retrieved chunks to the question
success_criteria: Relevant context retrieved for test queries
Answers grounded in retrieved evidence
labs.reset_guidance: Rebuild the index from source documents with baseline settings.

labs.title: Agent tool-calling loop
labs.scenario: An agent repeatedly calls tools without converging on a final answer.
tasks: Identify loop condition and missing stop criteria
Constrain tool use and state handling
hints: Inspect tool call history and termination logic
Add max steps and clearer success signals
success_criteria: Agent completes within bounds
No repeated unproductive tool calls
labs.reset_guidance: Restore baseline agent config and clear transient run state.

labs.title: Prompt injection and tool misuse
labs.scenario: Untrusted content attempts to override instructions or trigger unsafe tool actions.
tasks: Harden prompts/tool boundaries and input handling
Validate safe behavior on adversarial cases
hints: Separate system instructions from user/content data
Enforce allowlists and output checks
success_criteria: Adversarial inputs do not override policy
Only permitted tool actions occur
labs.reset_guidance: Reset to baseline prompts/policies and rerun the adversarial test set.

labs.title: Evaluation failure and cost anomaly
labs.scenario: An AI feature passes ad-hoc tests but fails structured evaluation while token usage and latency spike unexpectedly.
tasks: Identify prompt/context/tooling causes of failures and excess cost
Apply fixes and compare quality/cost metrics
hints: Inspect prompts, retrieved context size, retries, and tool loops
Track tokens/latency per request
success_criteria: Evaluation quality improves on target cases
Cost/latency reduced or bounded with no regression in correctness
labs.reset_guidance: Restore baseline prompts/configuration and rerun the same evaluation dataset.

domains.label: Machine Learning Engineering
domains.description: Troubleshooting scenarios for data, training, evaluation, and ML systems.

labs.title: Data leakage in evaluation
labs.scenario: Model performance is unrealistically high due to target leakage or improper split/preprocessing.
hints: Fit transforms on train only
Check for features derived from the target/future
success_criteria: Leakage source removed
Metrics reflect a valid evaluation setup
labs.reset_guidance: Recreate train/validation/test splits and refit preprocessing from raw data.

labs.title: Model degradation and data drift
labs.scenario: A deployed model’s performance drops as input data distribution changes.
tasks: Identify drift signals and impacted slices
hints: Monitor feature distributions and slice metrics
Consider retraining or threshold/calibration updates
success_criteria: Drift diagnosed with evidence
Mitigation plan validated on held-out/recent data
labs.reset_guidance: Restore baseline model/monitoring snapshot and rerun evaluation.

labs.title: Reproducibility and pipeline inconsistency
labs.scenario: Training results differ across runs due to uncontrolled randomness or inconsistent data/config versions.
tasks: Fix seeds, versions, and artifact tracking
hints: Control random seeds and data/config versions
Log environment and parameters
success_criteria: Runs are reproducible within expected tolerance
Key artifacts and configs recorded
labs.reset_guidance: Clear generated artifacts/caches and rerun from a versioned baseline.

labs.title: Class imbalance and misleading metrics
labs.scenario: A classifier reports high accuracy but performs poorly on minority classes due to imbalance and inappropriate metrics.
tasks: Analyze class distribution and confusion matrix
hints: Use precision/recall/F1/AUCPR per class
Consider resampling, class weights, or threshold tuning
success_criteria: Evaluation reflects minority-class performance
Mitigation improves relevant metrics without leakage
labs.reset_guidance: Revert to baseline data split/model configuration and rerun evaluation.
